description.value: Bean Scene HQ is a working roastery and café situated at the Landmark Business Centre in Kelowna, serving as the production hub for a small multi-location chain that bills itself as a pioneer of the Third Wave Coffee movement in the Okanagan. The on-site Probat roaster produces small-batch, artisan-roasted coffee strictly to order, ensuring freshness. An in-house wholesale bakery complements the café, turning out scratch-made items using local ingredients for lunches and pastries.
